sites.name: Boundary Creek / Saddle Pass upper access
sites.finding: Stored coordinate is north of the 49th-parallel boundary. The cited guide describes an approximate border/headwater bridge and forest-road approach but does not establish current lawful U.S.-side staging or exact water entry.
sites.action: Retained as rejected evidence with corrected label/note; route held.
sites.reopenWhen: Current land-manager or official map identifies lawful U.S.-side approach and exact entry preserving the advertised reach.

sites.name: Fremont Bay / Lakeside shoreline turnaround
sites.finding: This was explicitly a shoreline exploration waypoint, not a guaranteed landing.
sites.action: Removed the waypoint. The route is separately held until the Fremont Bay terminal ramp is located.
sites.reopenWhen: Current operator source confirms lawful landing and parking at this shoreline point.

sites.name: Sandy Beach boat ramp / Glendo State Park
sites.finding: The stored coordinate resolves to the Recreation.gov gateway in Glendo town, miles from Sandy Beach. Official park map labels Sandy Beach Campground but does not show a ramp there. No same-site replacement entry was verified.
sites.action: Renamed retained terminal as rejected gateway evidence, removed an unverified Muddy Bay waypoint, removed the misleading official-control entry, and held route.
sites.reopenWhen: Current park/USBR GIS or georeferenced map identifies exact public Sandy Beach water entry and route fit.

sites.name: South Hill Road High Tor marsh turnaround area
sites.finding: NYSDEC identifies a parking/trail-to-river access area, not an authorized boat landing. Route is a Sunnyside out-and-back; South Hill is a turnaround objective, not a take-out.
sites.action: Removed South Hill from route access list; kept the narrative turnaround context and Sunnyside endpoints. No route hold.
sites.reopenWhen: NYSDEC or another managing agency identifies a public boat landing and lawful carry.

sites.name: MD 136 / Priestford Road gravel take-out
sites.decision: reject: invalid stored coordinate; exact replacement unverified
sites.finding: American Whitewater describes a large gravel area downstream river-right of MD 136. The stored point is a church/street-address geocode, not that take-out. Imagery shows the bridge and nearby gravel area but does not resolve lawful landing or parking boundary.
sites.action: Kept old coordinate only as rejected evidence, removed misleading control, and held route.
sites.reopenWhen: Current agency/county source or field-verified map identifies public parking, lawful carry and exact water entry.

sites.name: County Road 4 bridge carry-in
sites.finding: Minnesota DNR identifies County Road 4 bridge at river mile 151.9 and specifies a hand carry on the downstream side. The coordinate is a bridge/access-area anchor; NHD offset alone does not show it is wrong.
sites.action: No coordinate change; keep route and existing carry caveat.
sites.reopenWhen: A surveyed feature or more precise mapped downstream-side carry endpoint is published.

sites.name: Pender Logan Creek canoe access (east side of town)
sites.finding: Official trail map shows a Pender access area schematically. The current state launch-layer query contains Bancroft and Oakland but no Pender feature; stored coordinate is not an exact verified entry.
sites.action: Retained as rejected evidence, labeled unverified, and held route. Corrected Bancroft/Oakland in separate follow-up.
sites.reopenWhen: Current agency/municipal launch feature or georeferenced operator map locates legal water entry.

sites.name: Orchard Creek trailer access
sites.finding: Minnesota DNR Cedar map names Orchard Creek trailer access at Cedar River mile 7.9. The source supports the access-area identity, not a surveyed Cedar shoreline point; offset is consistent with a named tributary/access-area anchor.
sites.action: No coordinate change; retain DNR map-derived anchor and field-verification note.
sites.reopenWhen: Current DNR launch feature resolves trailer approach and water-entry point.

sites.name: York Road Gunpowder access
sites.finding: Maryland DNR treats York Road as the boundary between harder upstream and easier downstream sections. VisitMaryland describes parking near a crossing, but reviewed sources do not verify a public water entry at this stored point or establish bridge-shoulder parking. Masemore-to-Monkton route remains independently valid.
sites.action: Removed waypoint/control pending verified water entry; route remains public.
sites.reopenWhen: Maryland DNR identifies lawful parking/carry and water entry matching the point.

sites.name: Highway 39 bridge
sites.finding: Wisconsin River Trips describes Hwy 39 as a possible/doable alternative bridge launch but does not establish current public parking or lawful bank approach. Main Ludden Lake and North Oak endpoints remain independent.
sites.action: Removed from the public access list pending current route-specific permission; no route hold.
sites.reopenWhen: Route operator or land manager confirms the bridge, public staging/parking and water entry.

routeDependencyReviews.site: Fremont Bay boat ramp / Boysen State Park
routeDependencyReviews.finding: USBR lists multiple Boysen ramps and Wyoming State Parks map shows Fremont Bay and ramp symbols. The stored coordinate is a Recreation.gov gateway/access-area point; neither the gateway nor schematic map locates the exact public ramp-water edge.
routeDependencyReviews.action: Retained as explicitly unverified access-area evidence, removed the optional shoreline waypoint, and held route.
routeDependencyReviews.reopenWhen: Current operator GIS/map or imagery resolves ramp entry and lawful vehicle/hand-launch approach.
